title: Web Vulnerability Scanner
description: A modular Python scanner for authorized web assessments, covering discovery, common vulnerability checks, session handling, and report generation.

sections.title: What I Built
content: The scanner is organized as a CLI-driven toolkit with separate crawler, session, scanner, model, and reporting components. This structure keeps discovery and assessment logic modular instead of coupling everything to one command.
The repository covers SQL injection, reflected XSS, path traversal, sensitive-file discovery, session handling, and report generation for controlled testing environments.

sections.title: Security Value
content: The project demonstrates how I translate manual web-testing workflows into repeatable tooling while keeping scope, authorization, and reporting in mind.
Its next maturity step is adding fixture applications, reproducible test cases, clearer severity logic, and sanitized output examples that show how findings become useful remediation work.
